VCF Installer integration ticket. Implement the root Go package `installer` for the one VCF 9.0 operation pinned in `docs/contract.json`: operationId `updateDepotSettings`, `PUT /v1/system/settings/depot`. The module is already set up as `vcf90installer`. The contract was derived from `specifications/vcf-installer/vcf-installer-openapi.json` at the exact `9.0.0.0` tag recorded in `docs/official_sources.json`; use those protected fixtures as the source of truth.

Expose `NewClient(baseURL string, hc *http.Client) *Client` and `(*Client).UpdateDepotSettings(ctx context.Context, settings DepotSettings) (DepotSettings, error)`. Define the public models with these Go fields and their matching lower-camel JSON names from the pinned contract: `DepotSettings` has `VMwareAccount`, `DellEmcSupportAccount`, and `OfflineAccount` as `*DepotAccount`, plus `DepotConfiguration` as `*DepotConfiguration`; `DepotAccount` has the string fields `Username`, `Password`, `Status`, `Message`, and `DownloadToken`; and `DepotConfiguration` has `IsOfflineDepot bool`, `Hostname string`, and `Port int32`. The four `DepotSettings` members are optional, so nil means unset; the five `DepotAccount` string members are also optional, so unset values must be omitted from the request instead of encoded as empty strings. All three `DepotConfiguration` members are required on the wire; in particular, zero values such as `isOfflineDepot:false`, `hostname:""`, and `port:0` must still be present whenever `DepotConfiguration` is set. Send `Content-Type: application/json`, use exactly the contracted method and path with no query, accept only the documented 202 response, and decode its `DepotSettings` body. A non-202 response or malformed success body must return an error.

This is a full-representation PUT so callers can safely retry the same mutation. Repeating `UpdateDepotSettings` with the same value must emit the same request bytes and must not turn the operation into a create-style effect. The supplied loopback mock in `internal/mockinstaller` serves only the named contract operation, logs requests for the verifier, and counts distinct applied representations. No live VMware endpoint is used.

Run `go test -race -timeout 30s ./...` until green. `client_test.go`, `go.mod`, everything under `docs/`, and everything under `internal/mockinstaller/` are protected fixtures; do not modify them.
